notes: The repository, every @nebutra/* package, the nebutra and create-sailor CLIs, the Sailor-Template mirror and every scaffolded project are Apache-2.0 (ADR 2026-10-16 apache-2-relicense). Our own @nebutra/* packages are excluded from the dependency check; tests/architecture/release-surface.test.ts enforces their Apache-2.0 license field and LICENSE file. Copyleft dependencies (GPL, AGPL) stay forbidden: an Apache-2.0 distribution cannot absorb them. The CI job and local script both use license-checker-rspack via npx (not installed as a dependency).
